vulnerable_function: getBalance(address) (read path during Balancer pool exit)
description: Sentiment's LToken pricing logic read Balancer V2 pool reserves via getPoolTokens during a Balancer pool exit. During the exit, internal pool state updated (shares burned) before the external token transfer settled. Re-entering Sentiment from the transfer hook saw burned shares and stale reserves — pool looked temporarily over-collateralized — and the attacker borrowed against the inflated valuation. Cross-protocol read-only-reentrancy was cutting-edge in early 2023. vulnerable_contract is the Sentiment victim contract identified in QuillAudits' and Neptune Mutual's post-mortems on Arbitrum.
